name: Hone front hydraulic disc-brake caliper with adapter
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 198 g for one front BR-M601 hydraulic caliper assembly with brake pads, mounting bolts and its International Standard adapter. The weight table explicitly specifies metal pads; the drawing identifies the M06 pad assembly. Lever, hose and rotor are separate components. The weight table does not identify the adapter size; no adapter or rotor weight is added or subtracted.
